environment: Windows Python 3.12 venv; casadi/cvxopt/do-mpc; pinned numpy<2, scipy 1.13.1, pandas<3 for compatibility
compatibility_patch: NumPy 2.x np.cross no longer accepts 2D vectors; pinned numpy<2. Matplotlib 3.x Line2D.set_data rejects scalars; patched main.py visualization only to pass [scalar] lists. Controller/model code unchanged.
limitation: Upstream is a 2-agent differential-drive MPC-CBF controller, not a 4-agent double-integrator implementation. It cannot be plugged into No02 MPC as-is without a new multi-agent CBF formulation.
